premiere.body: Charbel, the new feature film about Saint Charbel, held its special premiere on October 9 at BlackBox in Beirut Media Zone, according to Nidaa al-Watan's October 10 report. The film is a joint NMPRO and MTV production, directed by Nadim Mehanna and written by Claudia Marshalian, with Jerry Ghazal playing the young Charbel and Father Roukoz El Hajj portraying him later in life. Cinemacity lists a runtime of 130 minutes.

premiere.launchSource: Lebtalks: launch, patronage, MTV broadcast and planned Lebanese release (October 9, Arabic)
premiere.release: Lebtalks reported that the October 9 launch was under President Joseph Aoun's patronage and would be broadcast on MTV, with a nationwide Lebanese theatrical rollout planned from October 22. Cinema dates can differ by cinema: VOX City Centre Beirut lists October 21 sessions (Standard 7:00 and 7:30pm, GOLD 7:30pm; Arabic audio with English subtitles), while Cinemacity Beirut lists Thursday, October 22 as its opening date with no screening sessions scheduled yet. A listed session is a cinema listing, not a seat guarantee - check your cinema. The completed premiere and the upcoming public cinema opening are different milestones.
premiere.scope: An October 8 announcement scheduled a separate charity screening for October 12 at ABC Achrafieh in support of Anta Akhi. We have not verified a post-event report. International release dates, streaming distribution and any English-dubbed version remain unconfirmed; VOX lists the film with Arabic audio and English subtitles.
